identity: STHNN local reconstruction, not verified author implementation
architecture: Existing initial time-preserving scalar-node reconstruction; model.py unchanged. Known table/residual/norm ambiguities remain.
selection: PerFD choose lowest validation RMSE among original seed42 and2 fixed candidates, candidate eligible only if validation NASA at RMSE-best checkpoint<=1.2x original. Use validation predictions only. No official metric selection.
checkpoint: minimum engine-held-out validation-window RMSE; no early stopping
official: 20 newly trained final runs, one terminal prediction per official engine, cap125; predictions saved before loading labels; raw metrics separate
fairness_limits: Same historical5 seeds as our baseline; they were previously selected from10 using official outcomes. Retrospective paired comparison, not independent/unbiased evaluation. Equal reporting seeds does not imply identical tuning histories or exact author reproduction.
reporting: Report all5, mean/sampleSD, per-engine paired errors; no seed replacement. Original paper numbers separately labeled literature values. Never label local reconstruction as confirmed original STHNN. No guarantee of recovering paper scores.
automatic_budget: 8 source-only screen runs then20 final runs; no other candidates or automatic retuning
